$description: Quill, the app kit: the rail and drawer every app frame is built from, and depth and focus (PDR-010): the planes an app racks back to (soft, far, deep) and its named moves. Edit tokens here only; scripts/build-tokens.mjs generates everything else.

measure-rail.$description: An app's side rail (ui-app-frame): its sections and one action. Between the widths Artifacts and Mandate had chosen by hand.

measure-drawer.$description: An app's right drawer (ui-app-frame): what can be done with what's on screen, its filters and its settings.

frame-head.$description: How tall a page's head is (PageHead), and so where the frame's horizon runs (ui-app-frame, the Line look picked 6 Nov 2026): the rail's app block and the drawer's head end on the same line. The title and the main action sit in fixed slots above it.

measure-table-virtual.$description: The most a virtual Table (`virtual`) is tall before it scrolls inside itself: about ten rows and the header. A virtual table needs a height of its own, or it grows to every row's height and nothing is left to virtualise.

frame-overlay-below.$description: An app frame narrower than this (its own width, a container query) shows the drawer as an overlay from the right edge, opened on demand, and keeps a strip of its button in place of the column.

frame-icons-below.$description: An app frame narrower than this folds the rail to its icons, whatever the person chose at a wider width; its button opens the whole rail as an overlay from the left edge.

ring-gap.$description: How far the radial menu's ring of actions sits beyond the edge of the thing it was opened on, so the ring never covers its own subject.

ring-button.$description: One action's round button in the radial menu: a comfortable target for a pointer or a finger.

ring-radius.$description: The radial menu's radius when it is opened on a row rather than a tile: centred where it was opened, beside the row.

ring-hub.$description: The radius of the radial menu's hub: the round middle that says Cancel, and fills while an action is held to confirm.

ring-outer.$description: The outer radius of the radial menu's inner ring of verbs. The wedges run from the hub to here, each wide enough for its icon and its name.

ring-band.$description: How deep the radial menu's outer ring is: the band of targets (people, floors, folders) fanned out beyond an action, a comfortable target deep.

ring-seam.$description: The gap between the radial menu's wedges and between its two rings: a hairline of ground, so each wedge reads as its own target.

reel-card.$description: One card on a front page reel (a lane of what needs you, what's new, what's coming).

focus-far-blur.$description: Rack focus (PDR-010), the far plane: how far the app's work blurs when one surface takes focus in front of it (a dialog, the radial menu, the palette). Strips fine detail; the layout stays where it was, so you keep your bearings.

focus-far-saturate.$description: The far plane: how much colour the app's work keeps while one surface has focus. Less colour dials back peripheral noise without the black of a scrim.

focus-far-dim.$description: The far plane: how bright the app's work stays while one surface has focus. Dimmed with light, never a black scrim.

focus-far-scale.$description: The far plane shrinks this much, as a lens does when it refocuses on something closer.

focus-far-tint.$description: The faint slate the rack veil adds over a racked plane, so text behind it never competes. A tenth of slate-deep: never a scrim.

focus-deep-blur.$description: Rack focus, the deep plane: how far the app's work blurs when two surfaces are stacked in front of it (a dialog opened from the palette, a decision over a menu). Further back than the far plane.

focus-deep-saturate.$description: The deep plane: how much colour the app's work keeps two planes behind focus. Less than the far plane.

focus-deep-dim.$description: The deep plane: how bright the app's work stays two planes behind focus. Darker than the far plane, still no scrim.

focus-deep-scale.$description: The deep plane shrinks this much, a little further than the far plane.

focus-soft-blur.$description: Rack focus, the soft plane: the light blur, about a third of the far plane's, when something rises within the app's own plane (a needs-you card from its phrase). The app stays close behind it.

focus-soft-saturate.$description: The soft plane: how much colour the app keeps while something in its own plane has focus.

focus-soft-dim.$description: The soft plane: how bright the app stays while something in its own plane has focus.

focus-soft-scale.$description: The soft plane shrinks this little, a third of the far plane's step back.

ambient-blur.$description: Focus pull (PDR-010): the soft blur on ambient things while something else has pulled focus. Under a pixel, so words stay readable.

ambient-saturate.$description: Focus pull: the colour ambient things keep while something else has pulled focus.

ambient-brightness.$description: Focus pull: how bright ambient things stay while something else has pulled focus.

path-dim.$description: Navigation path (PDR-010): the opacity of a tree's rows beside the path you took. The path stays lit at full strength. 0.66 keeps dimmed words at 4.5:1 on slate.

moves.$description: Quill's named moves, each an alias of one of Common's durations, so a change of pace is made once.

motion-rack.$description: Rack focus: how long the app takes to go out of focus, or come back, when a surface takes focus (a drawer, the palette, a dialog). Common's motion-slow.

motion-pull.$description: Focus pull: how long something that needs you takes to pull focus to itself, and the rest to step back. Common's motion-calm.

motion-trail.$description: The lit path's trail: how long the line from the top of a tree down to where you are takes to draw itself after you move, each level starting a motion-instant after the one above. Common's motion-calm.

path-dim-1.$description: The lit path (PDR-010): the opacity of the current row's neighbours, one step from where you are. What is inside the current row stays at full strength. Hover and focus bring a row back to full strength.

path-dim-2.$description: The lit path: the opacity of the parent's neighbours, two steps from where you are. Below text contrast on its own, so hover and focus always bring the row back to full strength.

path-dim-3.$description: The lit path: the opacity of rows three or more steps from where you are. Below text contrast on its own, so hover and focus always bring the row back to full strength.

path-soft.$description: The lit path: the slight blur on rows three or more steps from where you are, so the furthest ones sit back. Under a pixel, so the words stay readable; hover and focus take it off.
